messages:
Maria J: Heads-up: were running a controlled fallback/drill in west-1 next Thu night (2026-04-01) 00:30-03:30 UTC for three consecutive nights. Purpose: validate graceful-deg routing, KV cache prefill, and the controllers traffic-shift logic under realistic low-load windows. This is an experiment/drill, not a production maintenance; well tag metrics so alerting noise is minimized. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/west1-fallback-drill
Alex G: Can you confirm traffic shift cadence and max %? Also which pools are in-scope?
Maria J: Cadence: 2% canary for 20m -> 10% for 40m -> 25% steady (never exceed 25%). Pools: west-1-primary, west-1-fallback, and west-1-kv-prefill. Controller job id: fld-2026-04-west1.
Tony (oncall): Oncall will monitor /slo/fallback-west1 and kv.prefill.hit. Pager thresholds in runbook. Abort criteria: p99 > 1.5x baseline for 10m OR error-rate > 2% sustained for 5m. If abort, controller rollback and 10m observation.
Siva R: We'll create a short advisory for Dedicated customers in west-1. No SLA changes, just a heads-up. Who owns that message?
Maria J: Siva can send the advisory. Mark it as "FYI - potential transient perf variance". Also add a support doc link for teams with pinned capacity.
Alex G: Will the experiment emit a metric tag so we can filter in dashboards?
Maria J: Yesexperiment.tag = fld-west1 and controller traces will include experiment_id. Well also add a temporary SLO advisory window in Console (no SLA edit).
ops-bot: Scheduled: controller runs job fld-2026-04-west1 at 2026-04-01T00:30:00Z. Logs will stream to #eng-sre-experiments.
deploy-bot: Enforcing deploy freeze for affected pools 00:00-04:00 UTC during experiment window.
Tony (oncall): Oncall checklist: 1) Watch /slo/fallback-west1 2) Watch kv.cache.prefill.hit and kv.cache.miss.rate 3) Validate controller traffic-shift logged percentages 4) Run abort command if thresholds met.
Maria J: Abort command (oncall only):
```
POST https://controller.internal/api/v1/experiments/fld-2026-04-west1/abort
Authorization: Bearer <oncall-token>
```
After abort: wait 10m then confirm green.
Alex G: Do we need to coordinate with infra for any temporary routing or BGP changes?
Maria J: No BGP changes. This lives entirely in the controllers routing plane. Infra is on standby for escalation.
Siva R: Calendar invite created for post-run review Mon 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC. Ops, runtime, and support invited.
Tony (oncall): I'll be on Night watch. Ping me @Tony if something needs immediate attention.
Maria J: Post-run cadence: daily AM summary in this thread, and a consolidated telemetry + decision doc after the three nights. Potential follow-ups: increased % ramp test, cold-start load test, or adjustments to fallback thresholds.
Alex G: Running a dry-run against staging controller today to validate the abort path.
Maria J: Thanks all. Small ask: please avoid non-urgent deploys to west-1 between 00:00-04:00 UTC those nights. I'll post the deploy-freeze to release-war-room as well.
Tony (oncall): Acknowledged.
Maria J: If anyone spots anything outside the abort criteria but concerning (e.g., cache churn, unexpected error classes), post it here and tag @oncall. Well iterate on the runbook after the drill.
